Subject: BlueCove MAP v0.2 — updated owners, acceptance gates, and next steps

Hi Samir / Elena / team —

Thanks for confirming owners and the blackout window. I've incorporated the changes and tightened the acceptance gates. Attached is MAP v0.2 and an SOW outline for sign-off. Highlights: 

Updated timeline & owners:
- Sandbox access: cutoff Aug 27 (BlueCove Eng + Redwood Integrations)
- Integration sprint: Aug 31–Sep 11 (owner: Elena Park; weekly status call owner: Elena)
- Performance baseline window: Sep 14–15 (CS to run scripted tests; see test script link)
- Pilot launch (limited traffic): Sep 28 (pilot cap: 500 requests/day)

Acceptance gates & rollback criteria (concise):
- Functional: All API endpoints return correct payloads for canonical dataset (pass rate >= 98%).
- Reliability: Error rate < 5% over a rolling 24h window.
- Performance: Median latency < 1.8s for baseline; if median latency > 2.5s for 3 consecutive days, initiate rollback.
- Cost guardrail: Pilot spend capped at $5k; Redwood will enforce alerting at 80% and auto-block at 100% with manual override via exec approval.

Next steps:
1) Ben to share pilot cost profile (EOD Wed).
2) Samir/Elena to review MAP v0.2 and confirm by Tue Aug 31.
3) I will create a shared tracking sheet and calendar cadence (weekly cadence Wednesdays 9am PT).

Samir — once you confirm final acceptance gates I'll convert the SOW outline into a DocuSign-ready SOW and send for signatures.

Best,
Marissa Cole
